verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented bulk-operation capability, such as batch edit, batch cancel, or bulk API endpoints. The API endpoints listed act on one item at a time (cancel one event, update or duplicate one link), which makes them developer building blocks. Attaching a workflow to multiple links, or auto-attaching it to new links, is an adjacent configuration feature rather than bulk operations across many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
